description: Estimated cost to make the recipe, provided by the recipe author for the recipe's stated number of servings. Scales automatically when the serving calculator changes the serving count.

fields.estimated_total: Author-provided estimated total cost for the full recipe as written
fields.servings: Number of servings that estimated_total covers (the recipe's stated yield)

scoring.method: cost_per_serving mapped to a 1-10 mesh axis via buckets
